title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2609.21267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing achieves the best overall score fidelity: executing 200 questions, 38.5% of a full run, yields 1.03 pp of MAE. We nevertheless deployed difficulty-stratified fixed subsets because of their operational simplicity, and show they transfer without recalibration to five other agent families and remain stable across calibration windows as short as one day. translated_title: 生产环境中的高效基准测试：对一个不断演进的LLM智能体的研究
translated_abstract: 生产环境中的LLM智能体在演进过程中需要被反复评估，但完整重跑智能体基准测试的成本很高。我们针对一个服务于数万月活用户的生产级数据分析智能体，研究了高效的周期性评估方法，并报告了第一手的部署经验。利用该生产基准测试的574次历史运行记录，按时间顺序划分为校准期和保留期，我们比较了随机抽样、历史缓存、固定代表性子集以及基于IRT的自适应测试方法。结果表明，多维2PL自适应测试实现了最佳的整体分数保真度：仅执行200道题目（完整运行的38.5%）即可将MAE控制在1.03个百分点。尽管如此，出于操作简便性的考虑，我们最终部署了按难度分层的固定子集，并证明这些子集无需重新校准即可迁移到其他五个智能体家族，且在短至一天的校准窗口下仍保持稳定。基于这一部署经验……
tldr: 通过对生产环境LLM智能体574次历史基准运行的分析，该研究发现多维2PL自适应测试仅需执行38.5%的题目即可实现最佳分数保真度（MAE仅1.03个百分点），而出于操作简便性部署的难度分层固定子集无需重新校准即可迁移至其他五个智能体家族。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 574 historical benchmark runs of a production LLM agent, this study shows that multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing achieves the best score fidelity (1.03 pp MAE) with only 38.5% of questions, while difficulty-stratified fixed subsets deployed for operational simplicity transfer without recalibration to five other agent families.
